interfaces: result: success with immutable record/event or rejection with unchanged record

behavioralConstraints: PLANNED READY and ASSIGNED cannot enter generic BLOCKED recovery
review progression follows the task requiredReviewRoles in QA then Architect then UAT/Product order
unrequired review stages are skipped without requiring fabricated approvals
all successful transitions require schema-valid event identity reason evidence and timestamp metadata
illegal stale invalid or under-evidenced transitions return the original record unchanged
failure and rework transitions retain all earlier history
invariants: transition authority is deterministic code rather than agent prose
the engine never executes reviews validation Git operations or persistence
history is append-only on successful transitions
a failed transition never mutates lifecycle state or history
pre-development dependency assignment and branch gates cannot be bypassed through BLOCKED
DONE is reachable only after MERGED and COMPLETION_RECORDED
examples: a task requiring QA Architect and UAT/Product follows all three review states
a task requiring only Architect moves DEV_VALIDATED to ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW and then MERGE_READY
a stale expected state is rejected without mutation
a QA failure moves through REWORK_REQUIRED before returning to IN_DEVELOPMENT
edgeCases: empty reason evidenceRef or eventId is rejected
duplicate required review roles are rejected
attempting PLANNED READY or ASSIGNED to BLOCKED is rejected
review target inconsistent with requiredReviewRoles is rejected

expectations: BOOT-010 and later orchestration modules can request transitions without editing state directly
task-specific required review roles determine which review gates are traversed
rejections preserve the exact input record for deterministic recovery
acceptedRanges: all lifecycle states declared by TaskLifecycleState
requiredReachableRanges: review paths with QA Architect and UAT/Product omitted when not required
failure states through REWORK_REQUIRED back to IN_DEVELOPMENT
generic BLOCKED only after development has begun
